categories.main_business_segments: Maanshan Iron & Steel Company Limited primarily operates in the production and sales of iron and steel products, including four main product series: special steel, wheels and axles, long products, and plates. These products serve industries such as aviation, railway, ocean, automobile, household appliances, shipbuilding, construction, and machinery manufacturing. The company also engages in extended processing, technical services, and trading related to iron and steel products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced ironmaking, steelmaking, and steel rolling processes, emphasizing technological innovation and lean management. It focuses on breakthroughs in key technologies such as ultra-high cleanliness control, high-speed wheel manufacturing, and low-carbon steel production. The company integrates digital and intelligent systems, including big data centers and smart operations, to optimize production efficiency and environmental performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include downstream industrial chain enterprises in automotive, home appliance, construction, railway transport, and energy sectors. The company serves both domestic markets, especially in Eastern China (Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shanghai, Anhui), and international markets, exporting products to countries including Australia and Saudi Arabia. It maintains strategic cooperation with 13 downstream enterprises and targets high-end and specialized steel product markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Eastern China, leveraging its location in Maanshan near the Yangtze River Delta region, benefiting from proximity to Nanjing and Hefei metropolitan areas. It also has subsidiaries and operations overseas, including Australia and Hong Kong, and exports steel products to multiple international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Maanshan Iron & Steel Company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the steel supply chain, focusing on ironmaking, steelmaking, and steel rolling. It sources raw materials such as iron ore and coal, processes them into steel products, and sells finished products directly to end users and through distributors. The company also engages in procurement and logistics management to optimize its supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes high-end orientation, intelligentization, greenization, and high efficiency. It prioritizes technological innovation in transportation, offshore, and energy industries, developing new high-end steel products and low-carbon solutions. R&D efforts emphasize breakthroughs in core technologies, digital transformation, carbon management, and product lifecycle optimization to support sustainable growth and market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of iron and steel products across various categories including special steel, wheels and axles, long products, and plates. Sales are conducted via direct terminal supply, distribution services, spot sales, and dealer networks. The company also earns income from related services, investments, and financial services agreements with affiliated entities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As one of the largest iron and steel producers in China, Maanshan Iron & Steel holds a significant market position, especially in Eastern China and in specialized steel product segments. It competes with other major steel producers under China Baowu Steel Group and other domestic steel enterprises. The company leverages synergy with China Baowu and focuses on product differentiation and technological innovation to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 81.8 billion, a 17.3% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to owners of RMB 4.66 billion. Total assets stood at about RMB 79 billion with net assets of RMB 23.3 billion, reflecting a challenging market environment with declining steel prices and profitability. The company is undergoing structural adjustments and aims for stable growth through strategic reforms and efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique product structure combining special steel, wheels and axles, long products, and plates, catering to diverse high-end industrial applications. It differentiates through technological innovation, high-quality and low-carbon steel products, and integrated R&D-production-sales systems. Its geographic location and synergy with China Baowu enhance its market responsiveness and operational efficiency, providing customers with reliable, specialized steel solutions.
